messages:
maria: Heads up — customer reported a Viewer was able to click "Edit project" in Console when a KMS key was attached. Repro steps below, this looks urgent.

maria: Steps: 1) Login as user with role=viewer on org X, 2) go to Project > Keys, 3) click key dropdown — "Edit" and "Rotate" buttons visible and clickable. Screenshot: https://redwood.screens/abc123 (redacted).

sam: Can repro on staging when I toggle the new role-migration flag. Not happening on older clusters.

alex: Can you paste the policy evaluation log for that request? rbac-service prints the matched rule normally.

maria: Pasted below (sanitized):
```
[rbac] request_id=rid-7 check=console.projects.update user=U:123 role=viewer resource=projects/678 matched_rule=policy:legacy-allow reason="fallback-legacy-role==editor"
decision=ALLOW
```

alex: That matched_rule is the problem — legacy-allow should not match viewers. Looks like the refactor that added the legacy-role fallback left an overly-broad condition.

jen: KMS side note: when the UI shows Edit for a key we also surface rotate/delete controls. Audit logs show one rotate event by that viewer yesterday. We need to treat any KMS admin actions as sensitive.

trent: Quick triage idea: add an explicit deny rule for console.projects.update & console.keys.* for users with role=viewer before the legacy fallback. That buys time while we fix the fallback logic.

alex: Agreed. Proposed quick patch (policy DSL snippet):
```
# hotfix: explicit deny for viewers
rule deny_viewer_project_updates {
  when user.role == "viewer" and action in ["console.projects.update","console.keys.rotate","console.keys.delete"]
  effect = DENY
  precedence = 1000
}
```

sam: I'll open INC-1127 and a PR against rbac-config. Also will run a small migration to clear any legacy-role tags that were set incorrectly.

trent: Also add an audit alert: if a user with role=viewer performs any key management action, send to #incidents and page oncall.

oncall-bot: Incident created: INC-1127. Pager duty paged: oncall@redwood (pagerduty).

deploy-bot: Canary deploy scheduled for rbac-config PR #467 at 2026-03-20T15:10Z.

sam: Hotfix applied to canary. Re-testing, viewer now gets 403 on the edit endpoint and UI hides buttons.

maria: Verified on customer staging: buttons gone, attempted rotate request returns 403 and audit logged:
```
{ time: "2026-03-20T15:12:03Z", user: "U:123", action: "console.keys.rotate", result: "DENY", rule: "deny_viewer_project_updates" }
```

alex: We'll still follow up with a proper patch to remove the fallback rule. I'll file a follow-up task to review role-migration code paths and add unit tests around legacy-role handling.

sam: PR for rollback of legacy fallback is drafted — link: https://github.com/redwood/rbac-config/pull/468. Tagging @eng-runtime and @eng-ml for awareness since some infra flags touch serving.

maria: Customer notified and temporary mitigation applied. Recommend we keep the explicit deny for 48h while we validate no false positives.

trent: Agreed. Marking triage->resolved after 48h monitoring and patch merge.

maria: Thanks everyone. Will update INC-1127 with final notes later today. :thumbsup:
